2 full system crashes in less than 30 minutes playing Vanilla for the first time after purchase. Tried proton experimental and GE Proton. Tried with settings high with frame gen, and settings around middle without Frame gen. Not sure why this game makes my system shit the bed to the point I have restart via case button. Refunded as I did not want to gamble $40 hoping I could fix it before the refund window.

Full AMD build on Pop OS, specs plenty beefy to run this at max. No issues with other RE Engine titles at max, nor any other game (save FF7 Rebirth which shat the bed every 45ish mins). Reading around and it appears with the expansion patch there are others experiencing hard crashes too.

 If there is an actual fix I would rebuy, I was enjoying what little I got to play. Its a shame optimization in games these days is such shit. Maybe with prices on hardware inflating devs will redirct their focus onto optimization instead of brute force with powerful hardware and the Frame Gen crutch.

it's a good game so far, i will say though, there are bug's, player's getting sent across screen, character controlling themselves, and other's, but the most annoying thing is the cut off's, people keep interrupting you while your doing something, NPC and all, that sh*t is annoying.
but so far I'd recommended it.

Apparently since people complained about how easy Normal mode was they added Hard mode, and of course I was one of them.

Hard mode? Makes you deal 1/15 HP damaged with a maxed out end game character from the base game in the DLC, and enemies kill you in 2-3 hits. So make normal mode piss easy and then make Hard Mode the most tedious and poorly designed difficulty ever conceived where you have zero opportunities to reliably kill enemies and therefor grind. 

For reference I tried the Trials at first and thought maybe I needed to try the DLC first instead? Nope, same issue. Apparently, when Hard mode said 'Seasoned Adventurer's' what they meant to say is 'Please make sure you are level 300 and have minmaxed relics and character before starting'. Oh want to change back? Sorry, better restart the entire game. 

I have no issue with wanting difficulty. I take issue with making every mob encounter a tedious 'spam your weapon ability constantly while enemies never stagger' fest, even with Dragonforged Dwavern enhanced base end game gear and being level 120. Why even bother releasing this when it actively penalizes players who already beat the end game on normal difficulty? 

If I could refund this garbage I would. Apparently Crapcom have no idea how to actually design difficulty in a game, evidenced by handing out the Eternal Ferrystone to all players rather than making it a reward to earn naturally or given on NG+ once the exploration has worn out it's welcome.
